newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinan President Arafat mourns China's Deng.
newsitem.headline: Palestinan President Arafat mourns China's Deng.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat on Thursday expressed sorrow at the death of Chinese paramount leader Deng Xiaoping.

"We received with great sorrow the news of the death of the paramount Chinese leader Deng Xiaoping and we personally send condolences to your friendly people and government," Arafat said in a letter to Chinese President Jiang Zemin.
"We express our deep condolences while recalling the virtues of the late leader," the letter, published by the Palestinian news agency WAFA, said.
